scope: One common dimensionless shape set; original resource values supply all weapon, aircraft and cloud scales

parameter_sources.antenna: Main/side exponents and width ratios extracted from the previously accepted local point-gain fit, normalized by that reference resource's own half-angle. Sidelobe weight power .625 is a rounded shared shape choice. No original beam width is stored here.
parameter_sources.chaff_expansion: Dimensionless radius/speed/density ratios and density exponent extracted from the accepted rational cloud-response fit, divided by its original global resource scales. Response scale 1 preserves the original density*time scale; not independently validated for every resource.
parameter_sources.receiver: Endpoint power mean p=8, saturating P/(P+1) and unit sensitivity are common model choices, not recovered native constants or per-missile fits. The power unit is in the raw game's power units, not a claimed watt calibration.
parameter_sources.motor: Common model choice q(u)=1+tilt*(1-2u)+bulge*(6u*(1-u)-1); unit integral over one stage. Force, duration, delay, mass endpoints and pressure knots remain original inputs; no trajectory/TRK fitting.
parameter_sources.aircraft_and_reflection: Projected-area fraction, log-aspect power, body-area fraction and smooth reflection saturation are common model choices, not per-object calibration. Raw dimensions, aspect factors, cloud radius cap, multiplier and envelope supply scales.
